<!-- markdownlint-disable -->

## Overview

With NIXL P/D on a hybrid Mamba model (prefix caching on, Mamba `align` mode), the decode instance now also gets the prompt's Mamba state at its last full block. So a later turn sent to the decode instance alone (conditional disaggregation) gets a prefix hit instead of recomputing the whole prompt. Opt-in via `kv_connector_extra_config.ssm_boundary_state_xfer`, off by default.

## Claims

- Flag on: the decode instance's prefix-cache hit rate on second turns goes from 0% to 59% (Qwen3.5-9B, 1P1D), with no accuracy change.
- Flag off (default), or set on only one side: behaviour is unchanged. P/D peers that differ still work.
- Pull mode only. The push connector is unchanged. Off with decode context parallel (DCP > 1).

## Validation

**End-to-end, 1P1D on 2x H200, Qwen3.5-9B** (`--enable-prefix-caching --enforce-eager`, attention block size 576). There are 100 GSM8K conversations, each with a different 5-shot prefix, sent with greedy sampling and 8 at a time. Turn 1 goes through `toy_proxy_server.py` (P then D). Turn 2 (turn 1 + answer + new question) goes straight to D.

| `ssm_boundary_state_xfer` | Turn-1 acc | Turn-2 acc | D prefix hit tokens on turn 2 | D hit rate on turn 2 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| false (default) | 0.84 | 0.89 | 0 / 123,032 | 0.0% |
| true | 0.85 | 0.87 | 73,152 / 123,251 | 59.4% |

Turn 1 runs the same code either way, yet 20 of its 100 outputs differ between the two runs. That's run-to-run nondeterminism from batching (vLLM is not batch-invariant by default), so the ±0.02 accuracy differences are noise.

**Unit tests** (H200, `vllm/vllm-openai:nightly` image with this branch's Python sources copied over the installed vLLM):

```bash
pytest tests/v1/kv_connector/unit/test_nixl_hybrid_boundary_state.py \
       tests/v1/kv_connector/unit/test_nixl_connector.py \
       tests/v1/kv_connector/unit/test_nixl_connector_hma.py \
       tests/v1/kv_connector/unit/test_nixl_push_connector.py \
       tests/v1/core/test_single_type_kv_cache_manager.py
```

- 446 passed (run online, since some tests need models missing from the host's offline cache).
- `test_fewer_blocks_with_hma[google/gemma-3-1b-it-512]` was not run: gated model, no HF token on the test host.

`pre-commit` passes.

## Details

**Why the hit was 0.** In P/D the prefiller computes N-1 prompt tokens and sends only its running state h(N-1). The decoder caches the prompt's attention blocks, but a Mamba prefix hit needs a saved state at a block boundary, and none was sent.

**Flow with the flag on** (N = prompt tokens after the prefiller's 1-token truncation, B = block size, b = floor(N / B) * B):

1. P, `on_new_request`: if 0 < b < N, records b for the request.
2. P, `build_connector_meta`: when the KV cache manager offers the align-mode state at b, pins that block (`touch`).
3. P, `request_finished`: puts the pinned block before the running state in each Mamba group of `remote_block_ids` and adds `remote_ssm_boundary_tokens = b`.
4. D, `get_num_new_matched_tokens`: if `remote_ssm_boundary_tokens` equals D's own boundary and the local prefix hit doesn't already cover it, asks the KV cache manager to reserve a real block at b.
5. D, `build_connector_meta`: sends `[boundary, running]` for each Mamba group. After the read completes, `cache_blocks` hashes the boundary block with the loaded prefix.
6. P, `update_connector_output`: unpins the boundary block once `finished_sending` reports the send. Aborted requests are also unpinned.

**Compatibility.**
- When N is already a multiple of B, the running state is the boundary state, so nothing extra is sent.
- If P sends the extra slot and D did not reserve one (D has the flag off, or is an older version), the worker lines up the block lists from the end, so D still reads just the running state.
- With DCP > 1 the worker lines up block lists from the start instead, which would misalign the extra slot, so the feature stays off. Hybrid Mamba NIXL transfers already require P and D to have the same DCP size, so both sides turn it off together.

**Core changes.**
- `MambaManager.reserve_external_boundary_block` (wrapped by `KVCacheManager.reserve_external_boundary_blocks`) is a small hook that doesn't depend on a particular connector. It works only before the first allocation and does nothing unless a connector calls it.
- Block sizing counts the reserved block like an internal checkpoint block.

**Cost (flag on).** One extra pinned block on P per Mamba group per request, held until D has read it, plus one extra state transfer per Mamba group.

**Not a duplicate.** Searched open PRs for NIXL + Mamba/SSM boundary state, prefix caching and conditional disaggregation. None sends the boundary state. #48195 (per-group hit length for hybrid models) fixes a different problem.

AI assistance (Claude Code) was used to write this change. I reviewed it and ran the tests and evaluation above.

@@ -132,6 +132,12 @@ python tests/v1/kv_connector/nixl_integration/toy_proxy_server.py \
     - In bidirectional mode, the decoder caches KV blocks for multi-turn conversations. This TTL controls how long those blocks are held before being released. Unlike the prefiller lease, this TTL is not renewed via heartbeats.
     - Example: `--kv-transfer-config '{"kv_connector_extra_config": {"decoder_kv_blocks_ttl": 600}}'`
 
+- `ssm_boundary_state_xfer` (via `kv_connector_extra_config`): Also send the Mamba state at the last full block of the prompt, so the decoder can reuse the transferred prefix from its own prefix cache. (Optional)
+    - Default: false
+    - Only for hybrid Mamba models with prefix caching on (Mamba `align` cache mode). Enable it when a router may send a later turn to the decoder without a prefill instance (conditional disaggregation). Without it, the decoder recomputes the full prompt on such a turn.
+    - Set it on both P and D instances. Pull mode only; ignored with decode context parallel (DCP > 1).
+    - Example: `--kv-transfer-config '{"kv_connector_extra_config": {"ssm_boundary_state_xfer": true}}'`
+
 ## Bidirectional KV Transfer (Multi-turn)
 
 In standard disaggregated prefilling, KV cache flows in one direction: Prefill (P) computes the KV cache and Decode (D) reads from P. For multi-turn conversations this is wasteful — D already holds the KV cache corresponding to the generated tokens from prior turns, yet P must recompute it from scratch on every new turn. Bidirectional KV transfer lets P **pull** existing KV blocks from D via RDMA before computing only the new tokens, significantly reducing Time-To-First-Token (TTFT) for long-prefill such as **multi-turn heavy scenarios**.

@@ -0,0 +1,273 @@
+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""NIXL P/D for Mamba hybrids in align mode with ``ssm_boundary_state_xfer``:
+the decode pod caches the prompt's last block-boundary state, so a later turn
+sent to it alone gets a prefix hit. Drives real P and D schedulers."""
+
+from unittest.mock import patch
+
+import pytest
+
+from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+from vllm.sampling_params import SamplingParams
+from vllm.utils.hashing import sha256
+from vllm.v1.core.kv_cache_utils import get_request_block_hasher
+from vllm.v1.kv_cache_interface import KVCacheGroupSpec
+from vllm.v1.outputs import ModelRunnerOutput
+from vllm.v1.request import Request, RequestStatus
+
+from .utils import (
+    EOS_TOKEN_ID,
+    create_model_runner_output,
+    create_request,
+    create_scheduler,
+    create_vllm_config,
+    make_kv_cache_config,
+)
+
+pytestmark = pytest.mark.cpu_test
+
+BLOCK_SIZE = 16
+FA_GROUP, MAMBA_GROUP = 0, 1
+
+
+@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)
+def _cpu_device_type():
+    with patch.object(current_platform, "device_type", "cpu"):
+        yield
+
+
+def _make_scheduler(
+    kv_role: str, num_mamba_groups: int = 1, ssm_boundary_state_xfer: bool = True
+):
+    vllm_config = create_vllm_config(
+        block_size=BLOCK_SIZE,
+        max_num_batched_tokens=256,
+        kv_role=kv_role,
+        kv_connector_extra_config={"ssm_boundary_state_xfer": ssm_boundary_state_xfer},
+    )
+    vllm_config.scheduler_config.disable_hybrid_kv_cache_manager = False
+    vllm_config.scheduler_config.async_scheduling = False
+    vllm_config.cache_config.mamba_cache_mode = "align"
+    kv_cache_config = make_kv_cache_config(
+        block_size=BLOCK_SIZE,
+        mamba_enabled=True,
+        mamba_cache_mode="align",
+        num_blocks=200,
+    )
+    mamba_group = kv_cache_config.kv_cache_groups[MAMBA_GROUP]
+    for i in range(1, num_mamba_groups):
+        kv_cache_config.kv_cache_groups.append(
+            KVCacheGroupSpec([f"mamba_extra{i}"], mamba_group.kv_cache_spec)
+        )
+    return create_scheduler(
+        vllm_config, kv_cache_config=kv_cache_config, hash_block_size=BLOCK_SIZE
+    )
+
+
+def _make_request(request_id: str, prompt: list[int], max_tokens: int) -> Request:
+    # Ensures the NONE hash is initialized, as create_request does.
+    create_request(num_tokens=1, block_size=BLOCK_SIZE)
+    sampling_params = SamplingParams(max_tokens=max_tokens)
+    sampling_params.update_from_generation_config({}, EOS_TOKEN_ID)
+    return Request(
+        request_id=request_id,
+        prompt_token_ids=list(prompt),
+        sampling_params=sampling_params,
+        pooling_params=None,
+        mm_features=None,
+        block_hasher=get_request_block_hasher(BLOCK_SIZE, sha256),
+    )
+
+
+def _run_prefill(
+    prefiller, prompt: list[int], request_id: str = "p-1"
+) -> tuple[Request, dict]:
+    """Prefill ``prompt`` on the producer until it finishes; return the
+    request and the kv_transfer_params handed to the decoder."""
+    request = _make_request(request_id, prompt, max_tokens=1)
+    request.kv_transfer_params = dict(do_remote_prefill=False, do_remote_decode=True)
+    prefiller.add_request(request)
+    for _ in range(8):
+        scheduler_output = prefiller.schedule()
+        if request.num_computed_tokens >= request.num_prompt_tokens:
+            model_output = create_model_runner_output([request])
+        else:
+            model_output = ModelRunnerOutput(
+                req_ids=[request.request_id],
+                req_id_to_index={request.request_id: 0},
+                sampled_token_ids=[[]],
+            )
+        engine_outputs = prefiller.update_from_output(scheduler_output, model_output)
+        if engine_outputs and engine_outputs[0].outputs:
+            return request, engine_outputs[0].outputs[0].kv_transfer_params
+    raise AssertionError("prefill did not finish")
+
+
+def _run_decode(
+    decoder,
+    prompt: list[int],
+    params: dict,
+    num_output: int,
+    request_id: str = "d-1",
+):
+    """Receive ``prompt`` from the prefiller, decode ``num_output`` tokens and
+    finish. Returns the local SSM block ids the decoder asked to receive into
+    and the generated tokens."""
+    request = _make_request(request_id, prompt, max_tokens=num_output)
+    request.kv_transfer_params = dict(
+        params, do_remote_prefill=True, do_remote_decode=False
+    )
+    decoder.add_request(request)
+
+    scheduler_output = decoder.schedule()
+    recv = scheduler_output.kv_connector_metadata.reqs_to_recv[request.request_id]
+    local_ssm_block_ids = list(recv.local_block_ids[MAMBA_GROUP])
+    decoder.update_from_output(
+        scheduler_output,
+        create_model_runner_output([], finished_recving={request.request_id}),
+    )
+
+    output_tokens: list[int] = []
+    for i in range(num_output):
+        scheduler_output = decoder.schedule()
+        token = 1000 + i
+        last = i == num_output - 1
+        decoder.update_from_output(
+            scheduler_output,
+            create_model_runner_output([request], use_eos=last, token_id=token),
+        )
+        output_tokens.append(EOS_TOKEN_ID if last else token)
+    decoder.schedule()
+    assert request.is_finished()
+    return local_ssm_block_ids, output_tokens
+
+
+def _decode_pod_hit(decoder, prompt: list[int], output_tokens: list[int]) -> int:
+    turn2 = prompt + output_tokens + [500 + i for i in range(10)]
+    request = _make_request("d-next", turn2, max_tokens=1)
+    _, num_hit_tokens, _ = decoder.kv_cache_manager.get_computed_blocks(request)
+    return num_hit_tokens
+
+
+def _turn1_prompt(num_tokens: int) -> list[int]:
+    return [7 + i for i in range(num_tokens)]
+
+
+def test_decode_pod_hits_prompt_boundary_after_nixl_receive():
+    """58-token prompt, block 16: P computes 57 tokens and also sends its state
+    at 48, so the decode pod resumes the next turn from 48."""
+    prefiller = _make_scheduler("kv_producer")
+    decoder = _make_scheduler("kv_consumer")
+    prompt = _turn1_prompt(58)
+
+    _, params = _run_prefill(prefiller, prompt)
+    assert params["remote_ssm_boundary_tokens"] == 48
+    assert len(params["remote_block_ids"][MAMBA_GROUP]) == 2
+
+    local_ssm_block_ids, output_tokens = _run_decode(
+        decoder, prompt, params, num_output=3
+    )
+    assert len(local_ssm_block_ids) == 2
+    assert _decode_pod_hit(decoder, prompt, output_tokens) == 48
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "p_xfer,d_xfer", [(False, False), (False, True), (True, False)]
+)
+def test_boundary_state_needs_flag_on_both_sides(p_xfer, d_xfer):
+    """Off by default; with the flag on only one side, the decode pod receives
+    only the running state as today and caches no boundary state."""
+    prefiller = _make_scheduler("kv_producer", ssm_boundary_state_xfer=p_xfer)
+    decoder = _make_scheduler("kv_consumer", ssm_boundary_state_xfer=d_xfer)
+    prompt = _turn1_prompt(58)
+
+    _, params = _run_prefill(prefiller, prompt)
+    local_ssm_block_ids, output_tokens = _run_decode(
+        decoder, prompt, params, num_output=2
+    )
+    assert len(local_ssm_block_ids) == 1
+    assert _decode_pod_hit(decoder, prompt, output_tokens) == 0
+
+
+def test_prompt_ending_on_boundary_sends_running_state_only():
+    """49 tokens: P computes exactly 48, so its running state is the boundary
+    state and one slot is enough."""
+    prefiller = _make_scheduler("kv_producer")
+    decoder = _make_scheduler("kv_consumer")
+    prompt = _turn1_prompt(49)
+
+    _, params = _run_prefill(prefiller, prompt)
+    assert "remote_ssm_boundary_tokens" not in params
+    assert len(params["remote_block_ids"][MAMBA_GROUP]) == 1
+
+    _, output_tokens = _run_decode(decoder, prompt, params, num_output=2)
+    assert _decode_pod_hit(decoder, prompt, output_tokens) == 48
+
+
+def test_prefiller_holds_boundary_state_until_sent():
+    """The boundary block must not be recycled while D may still read it."""
+    prefiller = _make_scheduler("kv_producer")
+    request, params = _run_prefill(prefiller, _turn1_prompt(58))
+    boundary = prefiller.kv_cache_manager.block_pool.blocks[
+        params["remote_block_ids"][MAMBA_GROUP][0]
+    ]
+    assert boundary.ref_cnt > 0
+
+    scheduler_output = prefiller.schedule()
+    prefiller.update_from_output(
+        scheduler_output,
+        create_model_runner_output([], finished_sending={request.request_id}),
+    )
+    prefiller.schedule()
+    assert boundary.ref_cnt == 0
+    assert boundary.block_hash is not None
+
+
+def test_aborted_prefill_releases_boundary_pin():
+    prefiller = _make_scheduler("kv_producer")
+    pool = prefiller.kv_cache_manager.block_pool
+    num_free = pool.get_num_free_blocks()
+    request = _make_request("p-1", _turn1_prompt(58), max_tokens=1)
+    request.kv_transfer_params = dict(do_remote_prefill=False, do_remote_decode=True)
+    prefiller.add_request(request)
+    scheduler_output = prefiller.schedule()
+    prefiller.update_from_output(
+        scheduler_output,
+        ModelRunnerOutput(
+            req_ids=[request.request_id],
+            req_id_to_index={request.request_id: 0},
+            sampled_token_ids=[[]],
+        ),
+    )
+    prefiller.finish_requests(request.request_id, RequestStatus.FINISHED_ABORTED)
+    assert pool.get_num_free_blocks() == num_free
+
+
+def test_decoder_local_hit_past_boundary_reserves_nothing():
+    """A decode pod that already caches the prompt has the boundary state."""
+    prefiller = _make_scheduler("kv_producer")
+    decoder = _make_scheduler("kv_consumer")
+    prompt = _turn1_prompt(58)
+
+    _, params = _run_prefill(prefiller, prompt)
+    _run_decode(decoder, prompt, params, num_output=2)
+
+    _, params = _run_prefill(prefiller, prompt, request_id="p-2")
+    local_ssm_block_ids, _ = _run_decode(
+        decoder, prompt, params, num_output=2, request_id="d-2"
+    )
+    assert len(local_ssm_block_ids) == 1
+
+
+def test_every_mamba_group_sends_and_caches_its_boundary_state():
+    """Hybrids such as Qwen3.5 have several GDN groups; the hit needs each."""
+    prefiller = _make_scheduler("kv_producer", num_mamba_groups=3)
+    decoder = _make_scheduler("kv_consumer", num_mamba_groups=3)
+    prompt = _turn1_prompt(58)
+
+    _, params = _run_prefill(prefiller, prompt)
+    assert [len(g) for g in params["remote_block_ids"]] == [4, 2, 2, 2]
+
